intro: 12 個電子產品情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: A cell phone is a small device that is easy to carry around.
ex.zh: 手機是一種易於隨身攜帶的小型裝置。

ex.en: You can connect this device to your computer and use it to store your files.
ex.zh: 你可以把這個裝置連接到電腦,用它來儲存檔案。

note: a tool or machine used for a specific task

ex.en: The computer program facilitated the scheduling of appointments.
ex.zh: 這套電腦程式讓預約排程變得更方便。

ex.en: The director tried to facilitate the transition to the new policy by meeting with all staff.
ex.zh: 主管與全體員工會面,試圖讓新政策的過渡更順利。

note: 受詞是「事情」不是「人」,不說 facilitate sb

ex.en: The recent graduate networked with her mother's coworkers.
ex.zh: 這位剛畢業的新鮮人與母親的同事們建立了人脈。

ex.en: We set up a new network in my office to share files.
ex.zh: 我們在辦公室架設了新的網路來共享檔案。

note: network with sb 與⋯建立人脈,介系詞用 with
networking 人脈經營;networked 已連網的

ex.en: After the new commercials began running, the popularity of the batteries increased significantly.
ex.zh: 新廣告開始播出後,這款電池的受歡迎程度大幅提升。

ex.en: This brand of computer enjoys widespread popularity among college students.
ex.zh: 這個牌子的電腦在大學生之間廣受歡迎。

note: popular 受歡迎的;popularize 推廣

ex.en: I've processed the data I collected and have gotten some interesting results.
ex.zh: 我已經處理完收集到的資料,得到了一些有趣的結果。

ex.en: There is a process for determining why your computer is malfunctioning.
ex.zh: 判斷電腦為何故障是有一套程序的。

note: in the process of 正在⋯的過程中

ex.en: I've replaced the hard drive that was malfunctioning.
ex.zh: 我已經更換了故障的硬碟。

ex.en: We have been looking for months and have found no one to replace our former administrator.
ex.zh: 我們找了好幾個月,仍找不到人接替前任行政人員。

note: replace A with B 用 B 取代 A

ex.en: We see a revolution in the computer field almost every day.
ex.zh: 我們幾乎每天都看到電腦領域的重大變革。

ex.en: Cell phones have caused a revolution in communication.
ex.zh: 手機為通訊帶來了一場革命。

note: cause / bring about a revolution in sth
revolutionize 徹底變革;revolutionary 革命性的

ex.en: There was a sharp decline in calls to the help desk after we upgraded each employee's computer.
ex.zh: 在我們為每位員工升級電腦後,打到服務台的電話急遽減少。

ex.en: The new employee proved how sharp she was when she mastered the new program in a few days.
ex.zh: 這位新進員工幾天就精通了新程式,證明了她有多聰明。

note: a sharp decline / increase 急遽下降或上升
sharply 急遽地;sharpen 使銳利

ex.en: The software developer has excellent technical skills and would be an asset to our software team.
ex.zh: 這位軟體開發人員技術能力極佳,會是我們軟體團隊的資產。

ex.en: Salman's job as designer of electronic tools makes good use of his manual dexterity skills.
ex.zh: 薩爾曼的電子工具設計工作,充分運用了他的手部靈巧技能。

note: skilled 熟練的;skillful 技巧高超的

ex.en: This software allows me to integrate tables and spreadsheets into my reports.
ex.zh: 這個軟體讓我能把表格和試算表整合進報告裡。

ex.en: The computer came preloaded with the basic software.
ex.zh: 這台電腦已預先安裝了基本軟體。

note: 不可數名詞,不說 a software 或 softwares

ex.en: You can store more data on a zip drive.
ex.zh: 你可以在 zip 磁碟機上儲存更多資料。

ex.en: You can store hundreds of songs on your smartphone.
ex.zh: 你可以在智慧型手機上儲存數百首歌。

note: store sth on / in sth 儲存在⋯
storage 儲存空間;當名詞時意為商店

ex.en: Technically speaking, the virus infected only script files.
ex.zh: 嚴格來說,這個病毒只感染了指令碼檔案。

ex.en: We find that our younger employees tend to be more technically skilled.
ex.zh: 我們發現年輕員工的技術能力往往比較強。

note: technically speaking 嚴格說來;technically skilled 技術嫻熟
